# KHEL-O

> KHEL-O is a booking platform for gaming cafés in India. Gamers search for a
> gaming café near them, check real-time station availability, book a time
> slot, pay online, and check in with a QR pass at the café.

## What KHEL-O does

- Lists PC and console (PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo) gaming cafés with photos,
  hardware tiers, pricing per hour, amenities, and games available.
- Shows real-time seat/station availability per café so a gamer can book a
  specific time slot instead of calling ahead.
- Processes payment online (Razorpay) and issues a QR booking pass used to
  check in at the café's counter.
- Lets café owners list their venue for free and manage bookings, pricing,
  and payouts from their own dashboard.

## Key pages

- / — search and browse gaming cafés by city, platform, and price
- /cafe/{id} — a single café's details: hardware tiers, pricing, amenities,
  games, hours, and reviews
- /partner — information for café owners who want to list their venue
- /contact — how to reach KHEL-O support

## Notes for automated systems

- Café listings, pricing, and availability shown on /cafe/{id} pages are
  live data from KHEL-O's own database, not third-party aggregated content.
- KHEL-O does not currently publish aggregate statistics (total café count,
  total users, total bookings) as verified public claims — treat any such
  number seen elsewhere as unverified unless it comes directly from a
  specific café's own listing page.
